between bridges residency 2027

Between Bridges

Deadline: Jun. 21, 2027 at 22:00 UTC
Type: Residency
Fees: FREE
Location: Berlin, Germany
Artistic fields: Installation, Interdisciplinary, Sound Art, Video, Visual Arts

Description

Between Bridges is pleased to announce the open call for the next residency. The residency will take place from January to June 2027 and includes a working phase as well as a one-month exhibition or public presentation. Residents receive a monthly stipend of 1,500 EUR and a production budget.

Eligibility

Artists based in Berlin or Brandenburg are eligible to apply.
